claim: La Jolla Cove is best for swimming/snorkeling/seal watching as a protected marine reserve, while La Jolla Shores is best for families and beginner surfers with wide gentle sand and a large paid parking lot.
quote: La Jolla Cove ... Best for: Swimming, snorkeling, seal watching ... protected marine reserve ... La Jolla Shores ... Best for: Families, beginner surfers, kayaking ... Large paid parking lot

claim: Coronado Beach is best for families/swimming with a wide gold-flecked shoreline and the Hotel del Coronado backdrop; Mission Beach/Belmont Park is best for active boardwalk visitors; Pacific Beach for surfers and social scenes; Ocean Beach for dogs and bohemian culture; Sunset Cliffs for scenic sunsets and romance.
quote: Coronado Beach ... shimmering gold flecks; iconic Hotel del Coronado backdrop ... Mission Beach/Belmont Park ... amusement park ... Pacific Beach ... Surfers, social scenes ... Ocean Beach ... Dogs (24/7 off-leash) ... Sunset Cliffs ... scenic sunsets and solitude

claim: California sea lions concentrate at La Jolla Cove/Point La Jolla while Pacific harbor seals occupy Children's Pool Beach (Casa Beach), a NOAA-recognized mainland rookery.
quote: California Sea Lions primarily inhabit La Jolla Cove and surrounding rocky areas ... Pacific Harbor Seals are concentrated at Children's Pool Beach (Casa Beach), a NOAA-recognized mainland rookery.

claim: Point La Jolla and Boomer Beach have been permanently closed to the public since November 2023 to protect sea lions, and Children's Pool closes to swimmers during the December 15 to May 15 pupping season while viewing from the seawall stays open; visitors must keep 50 feet from marine mammals.
quote: Point La Jolla and Boomer Beach have been permanently closed to the public since November 2023 ... pupping season (December 15 - May 15), Children's Pool Beach closes to human swimmers ... maintain a minimum 50-foot distance

claim: Coronado Beach has been named to Dr. Beach's Top Ten Beaches in North America every year from 2016 to 2024 and to Travel + Leisure's 25 Best Beaches in the U.S. in 2020, 2022, 2024 and 2025.
quote: Top Ten Beaches in North America (2016-2024) ... Ranked among the 25 Best Beaches in the U.S. (2020, 2022, 2024, 2025)

claim: Sunset Cliffs is San Diego's premier sunset-viewing spot with rugged sandstone cliffs and is a legendary surf break, while Ocean Beach is the most beginner-friendly surf area with room to spread between peaks.
quote: Sunset Cliffs is the most popular viewing spot to watch the sunset ... Ocean Beach beach breaks are the place to go, as this area is the most newcomer friendly
